metadata.tool: VC3D align_and_extract_umbilicus (villa volume-cartographer core/src/normalgridtools.cpp), compiled stand-alone against OpenCV stand-ins; un-crush option added (umbkit harness/)
metadata.coordinate_frame: x, y, z in full-resolution voxels of the volume (zarr level 0)
metadata.seed_aggregation: coordinatewise median of the per-seed estimates
metadata.smoothing: running median over 5 slices; points more than 3.0 mm from it rejected; ends trimmed to the first/last run of 3 consecutive kept, not-UNSURE slices, and an end stretch of <= 4 kept points separated from the rest by a jump > 5.0 mm is trimmed; control points = running median over 5 of the kept points in that range
metadata.unsure_rule: seed spread (median distance of the 9 estimates from their median) > 2.0 mm, or the seeds split into two clusters (complete linkage, each >= 2 seeds) more than 3.0 mm apart

kit_route_agreement.kit_method: port of VC3D align_and_extract_umbilicus (RANSAC 1000 x 10000 + weighted hill climb)
kit_route_agreement.kit_inputs: PHerc0175B m7 L2 skeleton + in-plane normals from m7st (published, label-free)
